channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Na Bahia, aliado de Flávio é denunciado por usar quadro com imagem de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Leandro de Jesus, state representative and federal candidate for the PL in Bahia and ally of Flávio Bolsonaro, was denounced to the Electoral Court for using a painting featuring an image of Jair Bolsonaro in his campaign, allegedly violating rules on the use of third-party images in electoral advertising. The complaint questions the legality of the campaign strategy and may affect the image of those involved. The case underscores debates on the limits of using political figures in election campaigns.

item.title: Ao lado de Flávio, Tarcísio sobe tom contra Lula e fala em sabotagem em SP
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas accused the Lula administration of sabotaging the state during a live broadcast with Flávio Bolsonaro, amid rising conservative rhetoric.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro reúne aliados em SP para gravar novo material de campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro meets allies in São Paulo to record new campaign materials for 2026. Among the invited guests are Bia Kicis, Tereza Cristina, Gustavo Gayer, and Tarcísio de Freitas, all candidates for majoritarian positions in different states. Michelle Bolsonaro did not participate in the recordings due to hospitalization for refractory migraine.

item.title: Flávio convida aliados para 'superlive' em TV Celular, alvo da campanha de Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro launched a 'superlive' on his TV Celular YouTube channel, alongside allies and Senate candidates, as part of Lula's campaign.

item.title: Dólar sobe com alta do petróleo, juros nos EUA e eleições no Brasil
item.description: The dollar rises 0.78% against the real, driven by oil prices, US interest rate expectations, and the presidential election. A poll shows Lula and Flávio tied, keeping market tensions.

item.title: Plataformas de IA generativa têm reforçado desconfiança no sistema eleitoral, diz estudo
item.description: Generative AI platforms increase distrust in the Brazilian electoral system, particularly regarding electronic voting machines and institutions, according to an InternetLab study. DeepSeek leads with 60% of distrust occurrences toward the voting system and 58% against institutions. Despite this, there is virtually no factual misinformation about elections (0.7%).

item.title: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini: IAs associam candidatos ao perfil do usuário, o que pode violar regras do TSE, mostra relatório
item.description: A report by InternetLab, LabDados/FGV and ReCoS reveals that AI chatbots such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini often associate candidates with user characteristics, a practice that may violate TSE Resolution 23.755/2026 by indirectly suggesting or prioritizing candidates. In 1,679 simulated conversations, between 49.6% and 98% of responses attempted to relate candidates to the user profile, representing indirect political-electoral influence.

item.title: Atlas/Estadão: Paes tem 45,7% no Rio de Janeiro contra 32,4% de Ruas e 8,9% de Garotinho
item.description: The Atlas/Estadão poll shows Eduardo Paes (PSD) leading Rio de Janeiro governor preferences at 45.7%, followed by Douglas Ruas (PL) at 32.4% and Anthony Garotinho (Republicanos) at 8.9%. In a simulated runoff, Paes beats Ruas 49.2% to 40.6%. Among state voters, Lula leads the presidential vote with 41.1%, ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro (40.3%).

item.title: Pesquisa Atlas/Estadão: Cleitinho tem 39,3% e Patrus Ananias 31% em Minas Gerais
item.description: Atlas/Estadão poll shows Cleitinho Azevedo leading with 39.3% and Patrus Ananias at 31% in the Minas Gerais race. The variation was minor compared to the previous survey, with Cleitinho ahead in all second-round scenarios. In the presidential race, Lula totals 48.8% and Bolsonaro 43.4% among Minas Gerais voters.

item.title: Atlas/Estadão: Tarcísio tem 55% contra 41% de Haddad no primeiro turno para governador de São Paulo
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) leads the Atlas/Estado poll with 55.2% against 41% for Fernando Haddad (PT), securing a first-round victory. In the presidential scenario, Flávio Bolsonaro outperforms Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva among São Paulo voters. The poll, with a 2-point margin of error, was registered with the TSE.

item.title: Como está a situação financeira do brasileiros, segundo pesquisa AtlasIntel
item.description: AtlasIntel survey shows 34% of Brazilians lack money at month-end, down from 40.2% in April. Rising food (44.2%) and utility costs (32.1%) are the top negative factors, outweighing debt and taxes.

item.title: Israel chama críticos de "papagaios" na véspera de discurso na ONU
item.description: The government of Benjamin Netanyahu released an AI-generated video on the eve of his UN speech, calling critics 'parrots' and accusing the UN of systemic bias against Israel. The campaign, titled 'The UN’s Lie Industry', was promoted by the Ministry of Diaspora Affairs and Combating Antisemitism. Leaders such as Lula and Macron criticized Israel's actions in Palestinian territories during the General Assembly.

item.title: Flávio faz live com Tarcísio e busca impulso em São Paulo na reta final diante do acirramento da disputa com Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro held a live stream with Tarcísio de Freitas and Ricardo Nunes to boost support in São Paulo, emphasizing Jair Bolsonaro's legacy and attracting undecided voters. Tarcísio compared Flávio's events to his father's legacy and urged votes for the PL, betting on anti-PT sentiment and victory.

item.title: Propaganda de TV de Haddad critica ausência de Tarcísio de debate
item.description: Fernando Haddad's (PT) campaign ad criticizes Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) for skipping a debate hosted by TV Record, highlighting the São Paulo governor's absence. The campaign uses TV airtime to question Tarcísio's stance.

item.title: Crise no STF domina campanha eleitoral e esvazia debate sobre proposta
item.description: The crisis at the Supreme Federal Court dominates the electoral campaign and sidelines proposal debates, benefiting Flávio Bolsonaro by exploiting the court's wear and tear, especially that of Alexandre de Moraes. Lula's campaign seeks to refocus on sovereignty and the president's statesman image, but struggles to impose its main themes while the crisis remains unresolved.

item.title: Tarcísio grava com Flávio e diz querer ver Bolsonaro subir a rampa do Planalto com o filho
item.description: São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas said in a video with Flávio Bolsonaro that he wants Jair Bolsonaro to take office with his son. The statement strengthens PL alliances and rallies conservative support for the 2026 election.

item.title: Nova pesquisa testa disputa entre Lula e Flávio no terceiro maior colégio eleitoral do Nordeste
item.description: A new AtlasIntel poll registered with the TSE measures the presidential race in Ceará, with Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro as main candidates. The survey includes first and second round scenarios, approval ratings of Lula, public image of other politicians, and perceptions on the country's direction and ideological alignment.

item.title: “Lula é Vorcaro”: Flávio reage a mensagens sobre o Master
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) posted on X stating 'Lula is Vorcaro,' reacting to allegedly extracted messages from Daniel Vorcaro's phone, owner of Banco Master, questioning possible contacts between President Lula and the banker.

item.title: Ex-coordenador de campanha de Bolsonaro no Nordeste ‘faz o L’
item.description: Former federal deputy Julian Lemos (PP), who coordinated Jair Bolsonaro's (PL) 2018 campaign in northeastern Brazil, released a video alongside President Lula, signaling a political shift. The over-two-minute piece presents a political retrospective suggesting alignment with the left-wing side.

item.title: Drauzio Varella vai formalizar candidatura à ABL na vaga aberta com a morte de Zuenir Ventura
item.description: Drauzio Varella will run for the open seat at the Brazilian Academy of Letters (ABL) following the death of Zuenir Ventura. The candidacy will be formalized after the memorial session for the late colleague.

item.title: Brasil, União Europeia e outros países defendem soberania e criticam ameaças e uso da força
item.description: At the UN, Lula defends Brazil's sovereignty and criticizes foreign interference, especially from the US, in electoral processes, reinforcing the stance of the Partners for Multilateralism group.

item.title: Tarcísio falta, Haddad vai: debates ainda impactam busca por votos?
item.description: With less than two weeks before the end of the first round of the 2026 São Paulo elections, Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad faced each other only once in debates, with the governor's absence being questioned by experts as a preservation strategy. Political scientist Leonardo Paz Neves highlights risks of debates with figures like Padre Kelmon, who may create chaos. Currently, Tarcísio leads the polls.

item.title: Flávio busca mobilização de Tarcísio, Nikolas e Michelle enquanto tenta se aproximar de Cleitinho de olho no segundo turno
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) intensifies his campaign 11 days before the election, mobilizing allies such as Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos), Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG), and Michelle Bolsonaro, while building ties with Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) in Minas Gerais for a potential runoff. Focused on the Southeast region, the candidate strengthens his electoral base in Rio and seeks greater visibility from his political sponsors.

item.title: Veja propostas dos candidatos ao governo de São Paulo para a Segurança
item.description: Candidates for São Paulo state government present varied public security proposals, including police militarization, increase in women's defense delegations, and tougher policies against organized crime. Security is considered the most important public policy by most Paulistanos, according to a 2026 survey. Some candidates, like Haddad and Tarcísio, consulted the same security expert.

item.title: Entenda como MG se tornou o estado que define a corrida presidencial
item.description: Minas Gerais is the key state in Brazilian presidential elections, as the candidate with the most votes in the state usually wins the presidency. With 16 million voters, MG reflects the diversity of the national electorate, characterized by pragmatism and regional heterogeneity. To win, candidates must engage with diverse realities such as agriculture, mining, and ecotourism.

item.title: UnB: aluna poderá refazer PAS após perder uma hora de prova devido a erro
item.description: University of Brasília student won the right to retake exam after losing an hour due to timekeeping error. Judge ordered Cebraspe and university to pay R$ 5,000 in moral damages. Case involves fraud in racial quotas and UnB investigations.

item.title: Michelle lamenta morte de Rick e relembra amizade dele com Bolsonaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro mourned Rick's death, highlighting his friendship with Jair Bolsonaro and recalling his musical legacy. Flávio Bolsonaro also expressed condolences. The plane crash that killed Rick resulted in five deaths.

item.title: Veja a agenda dos candidatos ao governo de Minas nesta quarta (23/9)
item.description: The Minas Gerais gubernatorial candidates carry out scheduled activities across various cities in the state, including walks, debates, and voter meetings. Patrus Ananias (PT), Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos), Gabriel Azevedo (MDB), Alexandre Kalil (PDT), and Mateus Simões (PSD) are active, focusing on topics like social housing, commerce, and public education. Indira Xavier (UP) and Hertz Dias (PSTU) also have commitments, including a national meeting on femicide.

item.title: Flávio é aconselhado a passar longe do debate das bets
item.description: Advisors to Flávio Bolsonaro recommend that he avoid directly debating online betting (bets), to prevent conflicts with companies in the sector, football clubs, and influencers. The senator has adopted a more cautious stance, advocating for reviewing existing rules instead of proposing an immediate ban on the platforms. The campaign strategy aims to link the expansion of bets to the Lula government, without making it one of the main fronts of Flávio's electoral speech.

item.title: Pesquisas internas de Lula começam a apontar tendência de voto útil
item.description: Internal polling from Lula's campaign indicates a trend toward strategic voting, with growth for both the PT candidate and Flávio Bolsonaro, alongside negative fluctuations for other leading candidates. The analysis suggests voters intending to support candidates with lower viability are migrating to Lula or Flávio as the election approaches.

item.title: Colinha eleitoral 2026: veja modelo e ordem de votação nas eleições
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian elections will take place in two rounds: the first on October 4th and the second on October 25th. Voters will cast ballots for federal and state (or district) deputies, senator, and president, following a specific order. Voters are allowed to bring a paper with written candidate numbers, and a valid photo ID is required even if expired.

item.title: Que aceno Lula fará ao PIB?
item.description: In December, the mood at the Planalto and PT was 'already won,' with Lula's popularity recovering after the tax reform approval and tariff hikes. Bolsonaro, convicted and jailed, pointed to Flávio as a candidate, but Tarcísio de Freitas was not the first choice. The PT's strategy appears consolidated for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Restringir bets como bebida e cigarro seria bom começo
item.description: The federal government is preparing a Provisional Measure to restrict bets sponsored by Caixa Econômica Federal, which generate R$ 12 billion in annual revenue. Although Lula disagrees with the practice, the Ministry of Finance supports maintaining lotteries, estimating that prohibition would significantly reduce tax collections. The initiative divides opinions, with critics highlighting state losses and supporters pointing to positive social impacts.

item.title: Quaest divulga novas pesquisas eleitorais em 6 estados e no DF nesta quarta-feira (23)
item.description: Quaest will release electoral polls on Wednesday (23) covering six states and the Federal District, measuring gubernatorial, senatorial, and presidential races. Lula (PT) leads in nine states, while Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads in seven, with technical ties in most major electoral colleges. The third round of polling in the Southeast region will be published throughout the day.

item.title: Empresários, acadêmicos e membros de campanhas: quem são os doadores dos presidenciáveis, que já receberam mais de R$ 10 milhões
item.description: Presidential candidates such as Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Zema have already exceeded R$10 million in declared donations to the TSE, with distinct donor profiles. Entrepreneurs dominate contributions, highlighting Erasmo Carlos Battistella, who donated R$500,000 to opposing candidates. Campaigns vary between individual donations, service payments, and support from government-linked figures.

item.title: Lula recorre a artistas e empresários na tentativa de conquistar votos na reta final do 1º turno
item.description: Lula turns to artists and business leaders to boost his campaign ahead of the first-round vote. He will attend events in Rio and São Paulo with cultural icons and economic elites, aiming to expand support and sway undecided voters.

item.title: A 11 dias da eleição, Lula aposta em medidas contra bets e 'Dark Horse'; Flávio mira em voto útil e crise no STF
item.description: With 11 days left until the election, Lula is expected to announce measures against online betting to appeal to evangelical voters and women, while Flávio Bolsonaro is betting on the 'useful vote' from right-wing sectors to consolidate support.

item.title: VÍDEO: Qual a ordem de votação na urna nas Eleições 2026?
item.description: On October 4, 2026, Brazilian voters will vote for six positions in the following order: federal deputy (4 digits), state or district deputy (5 digits), two Senate seats (3 digits each), governor (2 digits), and president (2 digits). Voters must select different candidates for the two Senate seats; otherwise, the second vote will be invalidated. Paper voter guides are allowed, but phones are prohibited inside polling booths.

item.title: Lula volta de NY e se reúne com coordenação da campanha para definir estratégia na reta final e discutir medida sobre bets
item.description: Lula meets with campaign coordination after UN trip to define final strategies and discuss betting restrictions. The campaign has intensified attacks on Flávio Bolsonaro and returned to issues like security and cost of life, seeking to mobilize the militancy.

item.title: O Brasil de Zuenir Ventura
item.description: Zuenir Ventura recounts the Brazilian political crisis of August 1961, when Jânio Quadros resigned and João Goulart returned from abroad amid uncertainty about his inauguration. The work describes a moment of democratic instability and threat of a military coup. The article is exclusive to subscribers and addresses political and institutional themes.

item.title: Violência política de gênero é “agressão” à democracia, diz Kassio
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Kassio Nunes Marques emphasized that gender-based political violence is an attack on democracy during the 'Political Violence HAS a Gender' event at the TSE. The meeting promoted the signing of a Joint Action Protocol between the TSE and the PGE to prevent and combat this type of violence, alongside the presentation of the Likeness ID technology, developed with Google, to identify deepfakes of candidates. The focus is on expanding female participation in politics and combating inequalities and threats against women candidates.

item.title: Ministros veem pedido de investigação de Mendonça contra Moraes como mais um impasse para crise no STF
item.description: Supreme Court justices see Mendonça's request to investigate Moraes as deepening the institutional crisis, with no clear resolution in sight. The dispute fuels polarization and may impact key issues such as the ethics code reform and the Master and INSS rulings. Consensus on conciliation seems to hinge on broader decisions, possibly postponed to 2026.

item.title: Uma aposta perdida
item.description: Federal government prepares provisional measure to restrict authorized betting, but faces resistance from the Ministry of Finance, which warns of R$12 billion loss in lottery revenue. President Lula lacks a decisive majority in Congress and relies on alliances for approval.

item.title: Chatbots de IA descumprem regra do TSE e ranqueiam candidatos a presidente
item.description: AI chatbots violated TSE rules by assigning scores to presidential candidates' proposals, creating a ranking. Folha's test with five generative AI tools shows how technology influences electoral perception. This raises concerns about the use of algorithms in election campaigns.

item.title: TRE-DF recua e libera propaganda de Michelle com imagem de Bolsonaro
item.description: The TRE-DF ruled to allow Michelle Bolsonaro's electoral campaign ads featuring images of Jair Bolsonaro, after determining that the STF did not explicitly prohibit the use of the former president's image by third parties. The decision overturns a previous suspension requested by Erika Kokay, based on the understanding that STF restrictions apply to the former president himself and not to others.

item.title: Zambelli pede salvo-conduto para voltar ao Brasil e votar na mãe
item.description: Former federal deputy Carla Zambelli, convicted abroad, requests a safe-conduct permit from the STF to return to Brazil and vote for her mother, a candidate for federal deputy in São Paulo, during the first round of the 2026 elections. Her defense argues there is a risk of arrest if she returns to the country due to convictions for digital crimes committed in 2022 and 2023.

item.title: Nova pesquisa mede disputa Lula x Flávio no quarto maior colégio eleitoral do país
item.description: A new Real Time Big Data poll measures the race between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in Bahia, the fourth-largest electoral college in Brazil. The survey, involving 1,600 voters with a margin of error of two percentage points, will be released on September 28. Lula leads with 55% of voting intentions in the first round, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro at 24%, according to the previous round registered with the TSE.

item.title: Em vídeos, bispos falam em soberania e orientam fiéis para as eleições
item.description: Catholic bishops, including Archbishop Dom Orlando Brandes, urged the faithful to vote based on the common good and national sovereignty in the 2026 elections, echoing key themes from President Lula's agenda.

item.title: TSE manda Lula apagar vídeo sobre Banco Master
item.description: The TSE president ordered Lula to remove within 24 hours a video about the Banco Master case recorded at the Alvorada Palace, considering that the content mixes institutional statements with electoral propaganda and uses public power elements irregularly. The decision responds to a request by Flávio Bolsonaro, who accuses Lula and Alckmin of prohibited conduct during the campaign.

item.title: Edinho Silva diz que eleição é 'contra a milícia' e anuncia mobilização nacional para o dia 27
item.description: Edinho Silva, national president of the PT, stated that the 2026 election is a contest between those who strengthen institutions and those leading militias, indirectly referencing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). He announced a national mobilization for the 27th, reinforcing the party's stance in defense of democratic institutions.
